verdict.rationale: Glama says you can deploy any registry server, or build one from a GitHub repo, Dockerfile, npm or PyPI package, on its own infrastructure. The endpoint you get back is the Gateway URL, with no proxy setup or manual wiring, and every call through it is logged, access-controlled and credential-managed. Server pages provide pre-filled config blocks for Cursor, Claude Desktop, Claude Code and VS Code, and the catalog lists thousands of remote connectors. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on confirmation that clients connect to hosted Gateway URLs, and documentation of the remote URL's transport and auth handshake for clients.
